cards.title: Drying Your Hair
cards.description: Ask to borrow a hair dryer and accept a simple invitation.
cards.scene: Two friends find a hair dryer for someone whose hair is still wet.
cards.briefing: Your hair is still wet. Ask to use a friend's hair dryer, then find a place to sit.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 머리가 아직 젖었어요.
lines.en: My hair is still wet.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 여기 드라이어가 있어요.
lines.en: There's a hair dryer here.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 잠깐 써도 돼요?
lines.en: May I use it for a moment?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 네, 여기 앉으세요.
lines.en: Sure. Have a seat here.

cards.title: At the Hair Salon
cards.description: Ask for a small trim and explain what you would like.
cards.scene: A customer and stylist agree on a small haircut at a salon.
cards.briefing: You want a small trim, not a big change. Check the length with the stylist and ask about your bangs.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 끝만 조금 다듬어 주세요.
lines.en: Just a little off the ends, please.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 이 정도 길이면 괜찮으세요?
lines.en: Would this length be okay?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 네, 앞머리도 조금 잘라 주세요.
lines.en: Yes. Please trim my bangs a little, too.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 알겠습니다. 불편하시면 말씀해 주세요.
lines.en: Of course. Let me know if you're uncomfortable.

cards.title: Returning a Borrowed Hair Dryer
cards.description: Thank a friend, explain a small accident, and check how to fix it.
cards.scene: A friend returns a borrowed hair dryer and points to its loose filter.
cards.briefing: You used a friend's hair dryer, but its filter fell out. Explain what happened and find out how to put it back.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 드라이어 빌려주셔서 정말 잘 썼어요.
lines.en: Thanks for lending me your hair dryer. It was really handy.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 도움이 됐다니 다행이네요. 머리는 잘 말리셨어요?
lines.en: I'm glad it helped. Did you get your hair dry?

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 제가 서두르다가 필터를 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: Yes, but I was in a hurry and dropped the filter.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 필터만 빠진 거면 다시 끼우면 돼요.
lines.en: If the filter just came off, you can put it back in.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 다행이네요. 다음에는 더 조심해서 쓸게요.
lines.en: That's a relief. I'll be more careful next time.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 제대로 끼워져 있는지만 확인해 주세요.
lines.en: It's okay. Just check that it's fitted properly.

cards.title: Sorting Out an Appointment Mix-Up
cards.description: Clarify an incorrect booking and agree on a workable alternative.
cards.scene: A salon customer and receptionist compare a booking message with a calendar.
cards.briefing: Your booking message shows the wrong time. Explain when you can arrive and check whether the new appointment fits your schedule.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 예약 문자를 보니 제가 부탁드린 시간과 다르네요.
lines.en: The booking message shows a different time from the one I requested.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 금요일 오후 세 시를 원하셨나요?
lines.en: Let me check. Did you want three on Friday afternoon?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 네, 그날은 일찍 퇴근해서 세 시에 올 수 있어요.
lines.en: Yes. I finish work early that day, so I can be there at three.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 세 시는 어렵지만 네 시로 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.
lines.en: Three isn't available, but I can move your appointment to four.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 그럼 네 시로 해 주세요. 한 시간 안에 끝날까요?
lines.en: Then four, please. Will it be finished within an hour?

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 머리만 다듬으시면 가능해요. 변경 내용을 문자로 보내 드릴게요.
lines.en: Yes, if you're just having a trim. I'll text you the updated details.

cards.title: A Suggestion, Not a Decision
cards.description: Clarify the status of a proposal before passing it on to others.
cards.scene: Two coworkers check a meeting note before sharing it with the team.
cards.briefing: A comment in a meeting might be mistaken for a decision. Clarify its status and agree on wording that leaves room for other views.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 아까 말씀하신 건 확정된 건가요, 아니면 제안인가요?
lines.en: Was what you mentioned earlier a final decision, or a suggestion?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 제안이에요. 다른 분들 의견도 들어 봐야 하거든요.
lines.en: It's a suggestion. We still need to hear what the others think.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 그럼 결정된 것처럼 전달하지는 않는 게 좋겠네요.
lines.en: Then we'd better avoid presenting it as a decision.

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 네, 검토할 선택지라는 점을 분명히 해 주세요.
lines.en: Right. Please make it clear that it's an option to consider.

cards.title: Keeping Shared Rules Fair
cards.description: Weigh equal treatment against different circumstances and explain a principled exception.
cards.scene: Two residents discuss a shared rule at a small community meeting.
cards.briefing: A shared rule affects residents differently. Discuss whether equal treatment is enough and how exceptions could remain transparent.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 모두에게 같은 기준을 적용하면 공정하다고 볼 수 있을까요?
lines.en: Can we call it fair if we apply the same standard to everyone?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 출발점이 다른데 기준만 같다고 결과까지 공정해지는 건 아니죠.
lines.en: When people start from different positions, the same standard doesn't necessarily produce a fair result.

lines.speaker: Min-joon
lines.ko: 그렇다고 예외를 늘리면 원칙이 흐려질 수도 있잖아요.
lines.en: But adding more exceptions could also weaken the principle, couldn't it?

lines.speaker: Leejin
lines.ko: 그래서 예외가 필요한 이유와 적용 범위를 함께 공개하자는 거예요.
lines.en: That's why I'm suggesting that we disclose both the reason for each exception and its scope.
